name: frame
title: The frame: grip with a palm swell, receiver and trigger guard round two cavities the cartridges pin into
orientation: On its back plate, the cavities opening upward, so nothing overhangs: as drawn. (It prints hilt-down as well, since no roof spans a cavity.) The cartridges go in open side first, the sled already in the barrel's slot with its rod out through the notch in the back strap; then the pins from the edges.

skin.rule: The frame round the cartridges: the grip's straps and the receiver's sides, rounded by as much

plate.rule: The back plate behind the cartridges: the disc rolls on its inside face

fit.rule: Round each cartridge in its cavity

depth.rule: The frame's thickness: the deeper cartridge, a fit, and the plate

guard_h.rule: The trigger guard below the receiver block: room for a finger

guard_post.rule: The guard's posts, front and back

smooth.rule: Segments round the corners and holes

swell.rule: The palm swell: how far the back strap bulges behind the grip column at its fullest

swell_r.rule: The swell's rounding, top and bottom

swell_lo.rule: Where the swell starts above the grip's bottom

swell_hi.rule: Where the swell ends, below the web of the thumb
